'''The Screeching Canyon''' was a canyon in the southern parts of [[Thousand Needles]]{{coords|28|48|Thousand Needles}} infested by aggressive [[Screeching]] [[harpy|harpies]]. The [[Roguefeather Den]] was located in the back of it.
